items.name: Trump after Qatari PM meeting: Iran 'militarily effectively over', US keeps 'status quo' blockade, 'locked and loaded'
items.headline: Trump after Qatari PM meeting: Iran 'militarily effectively over', US keeps 'status quo' blockade, 'locked and loaded'
items.source: Al Jazeera / ABC News live / Reuters via FinanceFeeds
items.claim: After the closed-door Oval Office meeting with Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani on 9 Nov (Vance present), Trump said 'Iran militarily is effectively over', that the US is 'keeping it the status quo... at the behest of countries that are their neighbours', described that status quo as 'a continuation of the greatest naval blockade in the history of our country' plus Task Force Iron Gate, said military action 'doesn't seem to be a very necessary thing' but 'we're locked and loaded', and that 'it's going to be ending fairly soon'. Reuters: Trump plans to keep the Hormuz naval blockade for now. Iranian officials called the remarks 'fake news'; Rezaei posted 'FOLD YOUR HAND'.

items.name: Qatari PM: 'positive discussions on reaching a deal'; two-day proposal presented; separate Vance meeting
items.headline: Qatari PM: 'positive discussions on reaching a deal'; two-day proposal presented; separate Vance meeting
items.claim: Sheikh Mohammed posted after the 9 Nov White House meeting that it covered 'ways to progress the US-Iran talks' and thanked Trump for 'positive discussions on reaching a deal'; Al Jazeera says he presented Iran's two-day proposal (Day 1 US lifts blockade/economic measures and releases partial frozen funds, Day 2 Hormuz reopens; Axios adds IAEA access to bombed sites on Day 1, which Iran's version omits). House of Saud: he met Vance separately earlier that day; no White House readout; nuclear talks would begin only after Day 2; no follow-up venue or date announced.

items.name: Qatar and Iranian official reject $8bn-for-Hormuz report; Baqaei says no new proposal submitted
items.headline: Qatar and Iranian official reject $8bn-for-Hormuz report; Baqaei says no new proposal submitted
items.claim: Gulf News live blog 9 Nov 21:08 GST: Qatar rejected reports that Iran would give up control of Hormuz for $8bn in frozen funds; an unnamed Iranian official told Fars the same day that reports of such talks were 'false' and talks are possible only within the seven conditions; Baqaei at his weekly presser said Iran had not submitted any new proposal and the two-day plan is 'the most practical framework'. CONFLICT: House of Saud (9 Nov 17:50 UTC) says no Qatari or Iranian denial had been issued. Follow-up to the single-sourced Israel Hayom report.

items.name: Iran denies planned Rezaei-Vance meeting in Doha; 'no plans for negotiations' without action on seven conditions
items.headline: Iran denies planned Rezaei-Vance meeting in Doha; 'no plans for negotiations' without action on seven conditions
items.claim: A senior Iranian security official told Tasnim on 9 Nov (20:01) that reports of a Doha meeting between SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei and VP Vance were false, that 'Iran's policy and plans concerning negotiations remain unchanged', and that without practical US action on the seven conditions 'there will be no plans for negotiations'. Gulf News logged the denial at 21:09 GST.

items.name: Pezeshkian: Khamenei ordered an end to 'neither war nor peace'; Iran open to talks 'with dignity'
items.headline: Pezeshkian: Khamenei ordered an end to 'neither war nor peace'; Iran open to talks 'with dignity'
items.source: Anadolu via A News / Al Jazeera
items.claim: President Pezeshkian said on 9 Nov (presidency website) that Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei directed officials to end the state of 'neither war nor peace', that 'we favor dialogue and negotiations' on the basis of mutual respect and equal conditions, but 'we will not surrender to force and bullying'.

items.name: Baqaei: still talking with Qatar and Pakistan; 'dire consequences' if US attacks resume; Araghchi 'Forever Wars' post
items.headline: Baqaei: still talking with Qatar and Pakistan; 'dire consequences' if US attacks resume; Araghchi 'Forever Wars' post
items.source: ABC News live / Gulf News live
items.claim: Foreign ministry spokesman Baqaei said 9 Nov (05:50 EST entry) that Iran is still in contact with mediators Qatar and Pakistan and would only sign a deal that 'fully secures the national interests' of Iran, warning renewed US attacks would bring 'dire consequences'; he called US nuclear allegations a 'lie' and re-pitched the two-day plan. Araghchi posted the same day that Americans are 'sick and tired of Israel bamboozling US administrations into Forever Wars' (Gulf News 10:22 GST) and said the proposal remains on the table with a severe response if attacks resume.

items.name: Rubio at G7 Paris: 'no progress' with Iran, demands 'outrageous'; G7 Middle East session set for 10 Nov
items.headline: Rubio at G7 Paris: 'no progress' with Iran, demands 'outrageous'; G7 Middle East session set for 10 Nov
items.source: The New Arab / House of Saud
items.claim: G7 foreign ministers met in Paris on Monday 9 Nov (moved from Marseille); Rubio said there had been 'no progress' in talks with Iran and that its demands were 'not just unacceptable, but in some cases outrageous and ridiculous and really not realistic' and negotiations 'haven't been very productive'. Germany's Wadephul said the G7 aims to prevent military escalation with Iran; Europeans want a return to normal Hormuz shipping. House of Saud: the G7 Middle East agenda is set for 10 Nov. US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi 10-11 Nov.

items.name: Trump: Hegseth 'won the war in Iran' as Massie files impeachment articles
items.headline: Trump: Hegseth 'won the war in Iran' as Massie files impeachment articles
items.claim: ABC live entry 9 Nov 17:32 EST: Trump said Defense Secretary Hegseth 'won the war in Iran', linked by ABC to Rep. Thomas Massie's impeachment articles against Hegseth (date of filing not given in the entry). Prior run noted Democratic calls for Hegseth's removal (Israel Hayom).

items.name: Trump expects to meet Xi and Putin at APEC 'next week'
items.headline: Trump expects to meet Xi and Putin at APEC 'next week'
items.claim: Gulf News 9 Nov 06:40 GST: Trump said he expected to meet Xi and Putin at the APEC summit next week: 'One of the meetings, I think, will be with President Putin and President Xi.' straits.live 9 Nov 20:15Z logs a report of a Trump-Putin 'double deal' linking Ukraine and Hormuz (Around Prague, not read). No Wang Yi statement in gate.

items.name: OFAC Iran Designation Update (9 Nov): Volta Shipping Services alias change only; no general license or waiver
items.headline: OFAC Iran Designation Update (9 Nov): Volta Shipping Services alias change only; no general license or waiver
items.claim: OFAC's only Iran action dated 9 Nov is an SDN entry modification: Volta Shipping Services LLC (Dubai, IRAN-EO13902, linked to Mohammad Hossein Shamkhani) alias changed from 'Volta Shipping Services FZCO' to 'Volta Container Line FZCO'; no additions, removals, general licenses or waivers. No action dated 10 Nov as of fetch. Trade press (straits.live 9 Nov 22:00Z, Blue Water 10 Nov) cites an OFAC false-flag alert covering nearly 300 Iran-linked ships, but its date was not confirmed (prior run listed a 4 Nov OFAC alert, out of gate).

items.name: Iran reportedly strikes radar/communications on Oman's Didamar Island in southern Hormuz
items.headline: Iran reportedly strikes radar/communications on Oman's Didamar Island in southern Hormuz
items.claim: Gulf News 9 Nov 22:21 GST: Iran reportedly targeted radar and communications infrastructure on Oman's Didamar Island (Musandam, southern strait); an IRGC official said systems 'used to facilitate the passage of ships' were destroyed. No Omani or US statement found; OSINT posts (not fetched) say burn marks were visible on Sentinel-2 imagery on 8 Nov, so the strike may predate the report and precede the overnight Qeshm strike. Single-channel, unconfirmed.

items.name: Saudi East-West pipeline targeted in Medina region; 'limited fire', operations unaffected
items.headline: Saudi East-West pipeline targeted in Medina region; 'limited fire', operations unaffected
items.claim: Saudi energy ministry said on Monday 9 Nov that the East-West crude pipeline was targeted in the Medina region, causing a 'limited fire' that was extinguished; 'pipeline operations were unaffected', no casualties; no claim of responsibility. The ~4 mb/d Yanbu bypass line was shut for several days in September after drone attacks Riyadh blamed on Iraq-launched drones.

items.name: Houthi ballistic and cruise missile at Riyadh intercepted overnight; Riyadh schools go online; aerial-threat warnings
items.headline: Houthi ballistic and cruise missile at Riyadh intercepted overnight; Riyadh schools go online; aerial-threat warnings
items.source: Gulf News live / Gulf News UAE brief
items.claim: Saudi-led coalition said early 10 Nov (06:29 GST) it intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile and a cruise missile aimed at Riyadh, plus a drone; civil defence issued then lifted a Riyadh early warning, with alerts in Abha and Khamis Mushait. On 9 Nov Riyadh issued and lifted an aerial-threat warning (10:25 GST), the coalition said it destroyed three Houthi missile-assembly facilities, and Riyadh schools announced online classes from Tuesday 10 Nov. Houthi death toll from the 7 Nov Sanaa strikes rose to 44.

items.name: Khor Mor follow-up: output still suspended, drone traced to Tuz Khurmatu; Iraqi PM orders joint probe
items.headline: Khor Mor follow-up: output still suspended, drone traced to Tuz Khurmatu; Iraqi PM orders joint probe
items.claim: Al Jazeera 10 Nov: the late-8 Nov drone strike on Khor Mor (Sulaimaniyah) forced suspension of gas to several power stations with KRG generation initially down 2,500-2,800 MW; Reuters reported the drone was launched from the Tuz Khurmatu area of Salah al-Din; no claim of responsibility, KRG blames Iran-backed groups for earlier attacks; Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi ordered a joint federal-KRG investigative committee. Rudaw/Kurdistan24 (snippets): fire under control, production remains halted (Dana Gas).

items.name: IRGC Navy claims two tankers, one a supertanker, left burning on 'unauthorised' southern route on Tuesday 10 Nov
items.headline: IRGC Navy claims two tankers, one a supertanker, left burning on 'unauthorised' southern route on Tuesday 10 Nov
items.claim: TASS Tehran dateline 10 Nov: IRGC Navy said two tankers caught fire on Tuesday off the southern coast of the strait on a route Iran had not authorised - one supertanker after striking a naval mine, the second allegedly transiting 'secretly' with US fighter-jet support - both with AIS off, halted and abandoned; it warned any vessel cooperating with the US military would meet the same fate. No vessel names, no UKMTO/JMIC confirmation found at run time. Separately, Iran's navy said late 8 Nov (03:38 UTC 9 Nov, TokenPost) a tanker was disabled by a mine east of the strait after ignoring warnings - also unconfirmed; straits.live logs the same claim at 10 Nov 00:30Z.

items.name: UKMTO classifies Khasab tanker fire as an 'attack' (warning 199-26); Monday entry may be a reclassification of the 7 Nov incident
items.headline: UKMTO classifies Khasab tanker fire as an 'attack' (warning 199-26); Monday entry may be a reclassification of the 7 Nov incident
items.source: Gulf News live / Gulf News UKMTO article
items.claim: Gulf News live blog 9 Nov 21:34 GST: a tanker was on fire 8 nm NW of Khasab, crew evacuated, and 'UKMTO has classified this incident an attack'; Gulf News' 10 Nov UKMTO piece says warning No. 199-26 on Monday reported another oil tanker 'attacked' off Khasab with crew evacuated. The position matches the 7 Nov fire (prior run) and 199-26 precedes advisory 200-26 (the 7 Nov projectile strike), so this is most likely the 7 Nov fire upgraded to 'attack' rather than a new vessel; Ambrey had upgraded it to war-risk physical damage (Riviera 9 Nov). Not counted as a new incident.

items.name: UKMTO: Hormuz traffic 'well below normal but not stalled', ~65% below pre-conflict
items.headline: UKMTO: Hormuz traffic 'well below normal but not stalled', ~65% below pre-conflict
items.claim: Gulf News (updated 10 Nov 04:54; live-blog 04:03 GST): UKMTO describes Hormuz shipping as 'well below normal, but not stalled', about 65% below pre-conflict, most transponder-on vessels using the northern Iranian route; ~30 US-facilitated transits/day 5-7 Nov per US naval data; CENTCOM 147 redirected / 5 disabled since July. Reuters' Kissler (BOK) said 9 Nov that 'crude volumes continue to move strongly through the Strait of Hormuz'.

items.name: Iran tells South Korea to keep its navy out of Hormuz reopening efforts
items.headline: Iran tells South Korea to keep its navy out of Hormuz reopening efforts
items.claim: Baqaei said Monday 9 Nov (reported 10 Nov) that Korea should 'refrain from sending its military forces to the region' after Seoul decided last week to extend the Cheonghae Unit's operating area to waters south of Oman, with a P-8A, an EOD team and unmanned minesweeping equipment, pending National Assembly approval, following months of US pressure to help secure the strait.

items.name: Etihad Riyadh/Dammam cancelled through 19 Nov; flydubai Dammam to resume 10 Nov; US Mission warns of airspace closures
items.headline: Etihad Riyadh/Dammam cancelled through 19 Nov; flydubai Dammam to resume 10 Nov; US Mission warns of airspace closures
items.claim: Gulf News 10 Nov: Etihad's Abu Dhabi-Riyadh and -Dammam flights remain cancelled through 19 Nov; flydubai's Dammam services scheduled to resume 10 Nov; on 9 Nov flydubai, Etihad, Flynas and Riyadh Air cancelled Saudi flights and UAE arrivals ran up to three hours late; the US Mission warned Americans of possible cancellations and airspace closures (no dates); no new UAE-wide restrictions.
